description: Multi-server Coolify deployment. Public *.${PUBLIC_TLD} via edge server, internal *.{server}.${INTERNAL_TLD} per backend server. Mesh OFF by default. TLDs + cookie domains come from operator env / config/domains.env — this file ships zero deployment-specific hostnames. Server identifiers (frontend/backend/experimental) are AISHA reference labels — forks override via their own profile copy or coolify/servers.json. See cloud-multi.json.example for the full AISHA reference mapping.

domain._notes: TLD values resolved by scripts/lib/derive-domains.mjs: env > profile (null here = operator must supply). Patterns stay declarative — they describe how subdomains compose with operator-set TLDs.

_exclude_notes: monitoring (Dozzle) is now wired into coolify/manifests/aisha.manifest + the redeploy waves, so cold-start creates the aisha-monitoring app and the resolver's logs.* domain has a real deploy target (no cold-start-verify coverage FAIL). Was previously excluded pending that wiring.

oauth2._notes: Operator declares OAUTH2_COOKIE_DOMAINS + OAUTH2_WHITELIST_DOMAINS in .env-prod-backup. Resolver fills from env; null here means template-only. Multi-zone deploys (separate public + internal TLDs) need comma-separated values so OAuth2 Proxy scopes cookies across both zones (memory: feedback_oauth2_multi_zone_cookies.md).

ai._note: Rezidence dat AI (local | hybrid | cloud). Šablona drží dnešní chování platformy; instance s modelem uvnitř meshe deklaruje local.
